picks.title: How To Be Great - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E1
picks.summary:
What does it really mean to be great in the Kingdom of God?
In Matthew 20, Jesus completely redefines greatness. While the world measures success by position, possessions and power, Jesus shows us a different way. True greatness begins by bending our knee to Him, enduring pain with perseverance, living under godly authority and humbling ourselves to serve others.
This message challenges us to examine what is truly first in our lives and reminds us that proximity to Jesus, not what we produce, determines Kingdom success. Following Jesus does not promise a life of comfort, but He faithfully walk
picks.reason: Examines true greatness through Jesus' teachings on humility and service.
